prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "sakna". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "miss".
Scene: An adult looking fondly and wistfully at a photograph of distant friends, an empty seat nearby conveying their absence.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "sakna = miss someone; picture wishing they were with you.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Jag saknar mina vänner.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
